body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5553c25a73903fb1cffa2ec9c3b943eb43d0c9c6.png)

# About
Advancements Go Beyond aims to add a lot of new Advancements to each vanilla tab of the game and new tweaks to the over-all vanilla game! It's a perfect mod for over-achievers, people who enjoy collecting advancements in the game and nice to have over all if you're playing vanilla-styled modded Minecraft due to some of the niche and useful tweaks.

**The mod is heavily work in progress and there is currently only new advancements available for the following tabs:**

* Story : 50+ New Advancements

The mod is being updated tab-by-tab meaning that I'm not working on multiple tabs at the same time. I focus on a single tab and add as many advancements as I can before even thinking of giving up on it and releasing the update.

**Tabs that have yet to receive new advancements**
* Husbandry
* Adventure
* Nether
* End
## Beware!
This mod alters the vanilla game's code, primarily the advancements to make them fit better with this mod. It also requires you to install **[Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements)** to run properly.
# Frequently Asked Questions
**What versions will the mod be available for?**
* The base version that the mod is being formed on is 1.20.1 however there will also be a version for 1.21.8 in the future for Neoforge

**What loaders will the mod be available for?**
* Base loader is Forge but again, there will likely be ports to other loaders in the future once the mod is in good shape and has enough content to be expanded.

**How many advancements are you planning to add?**
* I don't have an EXACT set goal for the amount of advancements I want to put in the mod but I do want all 5 of the vanilla tabs to have at least 50 new advancements.

**What are the plans for after all the vanilla tabs are finished?**
* I'll likely focus on bugfixing and improving the mod over-all, maybe later on begin adding new custom tabs.

**Am I allowed to use this mod in my Modpack?**
* Of course! Just be sure to credit the creator @TheCuteBunni @lecutebunni if you do so.

**Does this mod have Multiplayer compatibility?**
* I am attempting to make it as compatible with Multiplayer as I can, please be patient with me.
